summary.motive: Attack the interior read defender with a three-phase conflict — take the dive and lose the keeper, squeeze the keeper and surrender the pitch.
summary.whyItWorks: Any aggressive squeeze by the read key opens the keep lane behind a scoop-and-climb guard, and the arc block forces the end into a pure pitch relationship he cannot win.
summary.failureMode: The read key stays square and two-gaps, or the force corner refuses the pitch trigger and closes on the quarterback instead.

beats.title: 1. The Seatbelt Ride
beats.text: The quarterback reverse-pivots and seats the ball in B's belly at the midline hole while keeping both hands free and eyes locked on the uncovered 3-tech.

beats.title: 2. The Squeeze Gives It Away
beats.text: The 3-tech slants hard down into B's dive path. By taking the dive himself he vacates the keep lane — the ball comes out of B's belly instantly.

beats.title: 3. Bend Off the Reach
beats.text: The quarterback bends behind the tackle's arc block while the end constricts. The guard has scooped the Mike, so the keep lane is two defenders wide and empty.

beats.title: 4. The Pitch Phase
beats.text: With the end forcing width and the corner triggering, the quarterback extends the third phase. A takes the pitch with full momentum around the constriction.

relations.tell: The dive hits the exact midline of the guard-center gap and the quarterback reads an interior defender — veer reads the end instead.
